description: This file defines a logging system with classes for managing log files, logging messages with severity levels, and flushing log data. It includes enum definitions for severity levels, class declarations for LogFile, Logger, and Flusher, and their respective methods and members.

classes.name: LogFile
classes.description: Singleton class managing log file operations such as writing, enabling/disabling, and resetting the log file.

classes.name: Flusher
classes.description: Helper class that buffers log messages and writes them to the log stream upon destruction.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Main logging class used to create log entries with a specific component name and severity level.

methods.name: LogFile::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LogFile.

methods.name: LogFile::write
methods.description: Writes a line to the log file.

methods.name: LogFile::reset
methods.description: Resets or clears the log file.

methods.name: Flusher::operator<<
methods.description: Appends data to the internal stringstream buffer.

methods.name: Logger::operator<<
methods.description: Creates a Flusher object for logging with a specific severity.
